import numpy as np
class CMAEvolutionStrategy:
 def __init__(self,x,sigma,opts={}):
  self.mean=np.array(x,dtype=float);self.sigma=sigma;self.n=n=len(x);self.lam=opts.get('popsize',4+int(3*np.log(n)));self.mu=self.lam//2
  w=np.log(self.mu+.5)-np.log(np.arange(1,self.mu+1));self.w=w/w.sum();self.mueff=1/sum(self.w**2)
  self.cc=(4+self.mueff/n)/(n+4+2*self.mueff/n);self.cs=(self.mueff+2)/(n+self.mueff+5)
  self.c1=2/((n+1.3)**2+self.mueff);self.cmu=min(1-self.c1,2*(self.mueff-2+1/self.mueff)/((n+2)**2+self.mueff))
  self.damps=1+2*max(0,np.sqrt((self.mueff-1)/(n+1))-1)+self.cs;self.chi=np.sqrt(n)*(1-1/(4*n)+1/(21*n*n));self.pc=np.zeros(n);self.ps=np.zeros(n);self.C=np.eye(n);self.g=0;self.rng=np.random.default_rng(opts.get('seed',0))
 def ask(self):
  self.D,self.B=np.linalg.eigh(self.C);self.D=np.sqrt(np.maximum(self.D,1e-20));self.invsqrt=(self.B/self.D)@self.B.T
  return list(self.mean+self.sigma*(self.rng.normal(size=(self.lam,self.n))*self.D)@self.B.T)
 def tell(self,xs,fs):
  ys=(np.array(xs)[np.argsort(fs)[:self.mu]]-self.mean)/self.sigma;y=self.w@ys;self.mean+=self.sigma*y
  self.ps=(1-self.cs)*self.ps+np.sqrt(self.cs*(2-self.cs)*self.mueff)*(self.invsqrt@y)
  h=float(np.linalg.norm(self.ps)/np.sqrt(1-(1-self.cs)**(2*(self.g+1)))/self.chi<1.4+2/(self.n+1))
  self.pc=(1-self.cc)*self.pc+h*np.sqrt(self.cc*(2-self.cc)*self.mueff)*y
  self.C=(1-self.c1-self.cmu+self.c1*(1-h)*self.cc*(2-self.cc))*self.C+self.c1*np.outer(self.pc,self.pc)+self.cmu*(ys.T*self.w)@ys
